narrative.title: The Changelog Diff Anchor
narrative.scenario: A documentation tool compares two revisions of a protocol spec by finding the longest run of terms that appear in both versions in the same relative order — the anchor text both revisions share. Terms need not be adjacent, only in sequence. The diff viewer highlights that anchor length to visualize how much of the spec survived the edit.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the length of the longest sequence of characters appearing in both strings in the same relative order.
constraints: strings consist of lowercase English letters

testCases.explanation: The shared in-order anchor is "ace" — length 3.
No character appears in both strings.

hintLevels: Level 1: When the current characters match, extend the best of both shorter prefixes; otherwise drop one character from either string.
Level 2: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1 on a match, else max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]); empty prefixes are 0.
Level 3: Two rolling rows cut memory to the shorter string's length.
